name: Company Brain selected internal engineering dogfood v1
purpose: two bounded real repository investigation cases; not an untouched external holdout

source.working_tree: source unmodified relative to HEAD; other unrelated modifications present
source.note: Same repository document was used in earlier smoke at a different content hash; selected internal source, not a holdout.

reference_labels: labels/rubric.md (do not expose to model or ingest into source collection)

runtime_reference.note: Reference configuration only; verify current model bytes and runtime settings before any run. 8192 context is not proof input will fit. No model run is authorized by this preparation alone.

isolation: Use a fresh disposable database and separate collection containing only inputs/sources; never ingest inputs/cases.json, manifest or labels. Resolve IDs from actual scan; record them separately without changing this manifest.
exclusions: other repository files and uncommitted edits
live user database and existing smoke database
model runs, prompt tuning, product edits, git commits, pushes
claims of external holdout, general quality, production readiness, or semantic support inferred from citation validity
evaluation: Freeze before any v1 runs; retain every failure and output; independently assess references separately; compare only under pinned configurations and report observed limits.
